scope: Research prioritisation of independently discovered tumour-only DNA variants; no confirmed somatic classification without matched normal

DNA_screen.purpose: Explicit conservative research gates, not validated sensitivity or clinical probability thresholds
DNA_screen.mapping_and_base_quality: Native GATK FILTER only; no additional median MQ/BQ cutoff

population_screen.missing_value_policy: Unobserved or unknown; never convert missing/QC-filtered observations to measured AF=0
population_screen.ancestry_group_sampling: No minimum group allele count; apply the 0.1% cutoff to recorded QC-PASS grpmax AF regardless of group size

clinical_annotations: Caris Benign/pathogenic/rs annotations are retained; none alone proves germline or somatic origin
RNA_screen: Native Isovar fragment-ID unions (read names), MQ>=20, no secondary/supplementary/duplicates, NH=1 when present; no additional three-fragment cutoff

downstream.weight: Vaxrank affinity contribution sum * sqrt(supplied transformed gene value * alternate-supporting RNA fragment fraction)

context_review.population_lookup_failure: Stop the stage; do not convert to an absent population observation
context_review.conflicting_duplicate_genotype: Stop gather for review; do not select the most favorable record
